steps: Create an API key in your ElevenLabs account settings, with the monthly credit limit you are willing to spend
You enter the key yourself: switchboard connect elevenlabs --token-stdin  (paste it; no agent should ever be asked for it)
The probe calls GET /v1/models, which reads the model list and spends no credits
notes: Observed 2026-10-23 (ElevenLabs authentication doc): the key travels in the xi-api-key header to https://api.elevenlabs.io, and the doc's own example is GET /v1/models.

LOCKED DECISION (owner, 2026-10-23, CLAUDE.md ELEVENLABS-API EXCEPTION): voice generation calls go only through the local elevenlabs-api guard MCP server, which holds its own key in Windows Credential Manager. This definition exists so an account can be custodied and probed here; ADR section 7 mounts the guard as a binary upstream instead of calling ElevenLabs from a Switchboard toolkit. Do not wire generation actions to this provider.
The API has no account identity endpoint in the doc fetched, so the identity is the constant 'api-key' and the probe only proves the key is valid.
